transcript.content: Hi, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess... they brought me in because of work. At the warehouse. I... I keep doing things by the forklift. Like, I just freeze sometimes with my arms up. Or I copy the beeping noises it makes, and the hand signals the guys use. I also move the boxes around in these... patterns. Even when they yell at me to stop, I just... I keep doing it.
Have you been experiencing anything like hearing voices or sounds that others don't hear, or having thoughts or beliefs that others tell you aren't true?
No. I don't... hear voices or anything like that. Just the normal warehouse noises. And I don't really talk to anyone about my thoughts, so... no one says anything about them.

Have you noticed these kinds of behaviors—like freezing up, repeating sounds or gestures, or needing to move things in a particular pattern—since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently?
Not since I was a kid. It's... more recent. The strange behavior at the warehouse, and... the confusing talking. It's only been happening for... about six months now.
Have you noticed any physical symptoms like your body feeling stiff or rigid, tremors, or been diagnosed with any medical or neurological illness recently?
No... I don't think so. My body feels fine, I guess. No shaking or stiffness. And no one's told me I have any... medical problems. Just... what's happening at work.

Over these past six months, have you had any periods where you felt unusually sad, hopeless, or lost interest in things—or on the flip side, periods where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep?
No... not really. I just... I go to work and come home. I don't feel... unusually sad or anything. And I sleep fine, I guess. Just... normal.
You mentioned some 'confusing talking' — can you tell me more about that? For example, do you notice your own speech becoming jumbled, off-topic, or hard for others to follow?

Yeah... I guess. Like... at work. The supervisor will ask me which pallets are going on the truck. I try to explain it to him. But... my words just jump around. 

I'll start with the load sheet... and then somehow it's about my old house. Then fishing... or church boxes. I don't know. By the time I'm done talking... nobody knows what I meant.
Have you used any drugs or alcohol, or had any recent head injury, infection, or illness in the past six months?
No... I don't use anything like that. Just... regular stuff. No head injury or... infections. I haven't been sick. Just... normal.
Do you ever find yourself unable to speak at all, resist people trying to move your body or reposition you, or stay frozen in an unusual position for a long time even when you want to move?

I guess... yeah. That's... sort of why they brought me in. At the warehouse, I just... I don't know. I freeze sometimes. Like right by the forklift... just standing there with my arms up. 

And I... I copy the beeping sounds it makes. The hand signals, too. Or I'll just start moving the boxes in these... strange little patterns. Everyone yells at me to stop... but I just keep doing it. I don't... I don't really want to talk about it.
